about.title: Full stack in practice.
about.p1: I'm a Full Stack Software Engineer with 4+ years of experience shipping complete web products. On the back end, I build REST APIs, complex business rules and data models with PHP and Laravel, plus BFF layers in Node.js integrated with microservices. On the front end, I build scalable interfaces with Vue.js, React, Angular and TypeScript.
about.p2: I helped build a financial platform from scratch, from architecture to deploy, and developed high-availability micro frontend applications at Equifax and Boa Vista. I also bring Artificial Intelligence into real products: financial reports generated through chat from SQL queries, and MCPs that connect applications to AI agents.
about.p3: I care about quality at every layer, with unit and E2E tests (Jest, Vitest and Cypress), design systems documented in Storybook, and code reviews. I've worked as a tech lead and as an onboarding buddy for new developers.
